text: Every Monday night, Everpeak's Azure ML Batch Endpoint scores all ~40,000 accounts and writes a score into dbo.ChurnRiskScores.
A flagged account doesn't just get a number -- it gets a sentence: usage down 62% over 90 days, two open support tickets, one unresolved for 14 days.
That reason tells a rep which conversation to have. Usage decline calls for an adoption check-in; open tickets call for an escalation before any renewal talk.
No outreach is automated here. Every email and call to a flagged account is still a human decision, made by a rep who read the reason first.
A real V2 idea, not yet built: an LLM drafting outreach grounded in that same SHAP reason, for a rep to review and send -- never on its own.
